geography.summary: The exact source has seven disconnected coverage components: the mainland and six offshore groups. The northern group includes San Miguel, Santa Rosa, Santa Cruz and Anacapa; retained water census polygons already connect those islands. These are census land-and-water coverage components, not seven dry-land islands. Labels follow source bounds and official regional maps. All six selected gaps lie in the offshore Pacific context shown by NOAA/FWS; this is geographic attribution, not an independent high-resolution global land-mask certificate.

optimizer_starting_point.recommendation: Start with a traced 52-district pilot using a 1,000 inner-iteration cap; measure termination, memory, final balance and independent connectivity before the larger anchors. California has no measured solver baseline yet.
optimizer_starting_point.workload: California has 519,723 blocks versus New York’s 288,819 (1.80×). Its 52/69/83/120 district matrices are 3.54–3.60× the corresponding New York anchor matrices. This is not a runtime prediction. Four dense float64 matrices alone total about 1.86 GiB at 120 districts; total process memory is higher. Run serially.
